_doc: The update rehearsal's container legs (story 59.12): the image's updates in NAS shapes. tests/nas/update_leg.py runs one; .github/workflows/update-rehearsal.yml runs every leg on its architectures. A leg takes the fields of a nas-shapes cell (tests/nas/cells.json: user, data, media, docker, env) and its steps (update, rollback, restore, and its own: restart, older) with its assertions.

legs.name: nas-568
legs.about: TrueNAS's apps user 568, the library mounted read-only, the data folder group-writable

legs.name: nas-4g
legs.about: a 4 GB memory limit (the Light tier) and a library of 20,000 videos: the dump and the new runtime compete for memory and disk

legs.name: nas-arm64
legs.about: an arm64 NAS (a Synology or TrueNAS on ARM, a Raspberry Pi 5)

legs.name: nas-restart
legs.about: the NAS stops the container in the middle of an update (DSM's stop all before its own update, a TrueNAS app restart): staged, moved, before confirm

legs.name: nas-image-older
legs.about: the volume on N+1 and the image N started (a household pinned an older tag): N+1 runs, and Settings says why
